source: RFC 7914 section 11, Test Vectors for PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA-256

_provenance.producer: IETF RFC 7914 (The scrypt Password-Based Key Derivation Function), section 11
_provenance.selection: Both vectors the section prints. tcId 1 (c = 1) is below the Rust engine's 1000-iteration floor, which it refuses by policy (open gap pbkdf2-min-iterations-divergence); readers default to tcId 2 (c = 80000).
_provenance.field_mapping: password/salt are the RFC's ASCII strings hex-encoded (the text also kept as passwordText/saltText); iterations <- c; dkLen <- dkLen; dk <- the hex block, whitespace removed.
_provenance.independent_check: Both recomputed with Python hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha256'); both reproduce the RFC's value.
_provenance.correction: REPLACES pbkdf2_test.json's three Node/OpenSSL-generated PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256 cases.
